title: "Study Design Tool"
page-layout: full
toc: false
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap">
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" integrity="sha256-p4NxAoJBhIINfQ3qFnAtFP7Htu6jo9tMZrA2ykXH0g=" crossorigin="">
        <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet.draw/1.0.4/leaflet.draw.css">
        <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js" integrity="sha256-20nQCchB9co0qIjJZRGuk2/Z9VM+kNiyxNV1lvTlZBo=" crossorigin=""></script>
        <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/leaflet.draw/1.0.4/leaflet.draw.js"></script>
        <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@turf/turf@7/turf.min.js"></script>
        <!-- gl3d-only Plotly bundle (surface + scatter3d): 1.7 MB rather than 4.8 MB. -->
        <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/plotly.js/2.35.3/plotly-gl3d.min.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<style>
  :root {
    --page: #FFFFFF;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --surface-2: #F1F6F7;
    --line: #DAE3E5;
    --line-strong: #BCCBCE;
    --ink: #1F2C31;
    --ink-2: #536268;
    --ink-3: #78888E;
    --accent: #2780E3;
    --accent-ink: #1B62B0;
    --accent-soft: #E3EEFB;
    --measured: #1A6B4E;
    --measured-soft: #DCEDE4;
    --derived: #86570A;
    --derived-soft: #F6E9CF;
    --flag: #A33227;
    --flag-soft: #F8E4E1;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(31, 44, 49, .05), 0 6px 18px rgba(31, 44, 49, .07);
    --sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
    --mono: ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
  }
  body.quarto-dark, :root[data-bs-theme="dark"] {
    --page: #181818;
    --surface: #212121;
    --surface-2: #2A2A2A;
    --line: #3A3A3A;
    --line-strong: #4E4E4E;
    --ink: #F2F2F2;
    --ink-2: #BFC6C8;
    --ink-3: #939A9D;
    --accent: #75AADB;
    --accent-ink: #9CC6EC;
    --accent-soft: #23323F;
    --measured: #6DC49B;
    --measured-soft: #1B2F27;
    --derived: #DCA847;
    --derived-soft: #342A12;
    --flag: #E08278;
    --flag-soft: #3A211E;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.5), 0 8px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }

  #study-design * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  #study-design {
    max-width: 1280px;
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--sans);
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.55;
  }
  #study-design h1, #study-design h2, #study-design h3, #study-design h4 { margin: 0; font-weight: 700; }
  #study-design .page-head { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 14px; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #study-design .page-head p { margin: 8px 0 0; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 78ch; }
  #study-design .layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 340px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; align-items: start; }
  #study-design .panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); }
  #study-design .panel h2 { font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  #study-design .panel h3 { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; color: var(--ink-3); margin: 18px 0 8px; }
  #study-design .note { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 10px; }
  #study-design .field { margin: 10px 0 14px; }
  #study-design .field label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: baseline; color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 5px; }
  #study-design .field label b { color: var(--ink); }
  #study-design .val { font-family: var(--mono); color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #study-design input[type="range"] { width: 100%; accent-color: var(--accent); }
  #study-design select, #study-design input[type="number"] {
    width: 100%; font: inherit; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
    border-radius: 7px; padding: 7px 9px;
  }
  #study-design .two { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
  #study-design .actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
  #study-design .btn {
    font: inherit; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 14px;
    border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
  }
  #study-design .btn.ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--accent-ink); }
  #study-design .btn:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
  #study-design .map-panel { padding: 0; overflow: hidden; min-width: 0; }
  #study-map { height: min(68vh, 720px); min-height: 520px; width: 100%; min-width: 0; background: var(--surface-2); position: relative; }

  /* Keep Quarto/Bootstrap's global image rules from altering Leaflet tiles. */
  #study-map .leaflet-tile {
    position: absolute !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    max-height: none !important;
    width: 256px;
    height: 256px;
  }
  #study-map .leaflet-pane img {
    max-width: none !important;
  }
  #study-design .map-help { padding: 10px 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #study-design .summary { margin-top: 18px; }
  #study-design .summary h2 { font-size: 19px; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  #study-design .metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
  #study-design .metric { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px; }
  #study-design .metric .k { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 10.5px; }
  #study-design .metric .v { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; margin-top: 2px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #study-design .metric .sub { color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 11.5px; margin-top: 2px; }
  #study-design .status { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
  #study-design .status-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 9px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #study-design .status-row .ic { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; }
  #study-design .status-row.ok .ic { color: var(--measured); }
  #study-design .status-row.warn .ic { color: var(--derived); }
  #study-design .status-row b { color: var(--ink); }
  #study-design .empty { margin-top: 12px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong); border-radius: 9px; padding: 15px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #study-design .badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; border-radius:4px; padding:3px 7px; }
  #study-design .badge.derived { color:var(--derived); background:var(--derived-soft); }
  #study-design .dive-card { margin-top: 12px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1.2fr) minmax(220px, .8fr); gap: 12px; }
  #study-design .dive-visual, #study-design .dive-stats { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 9px; padding: 12px; }
  #study-design .dive-visual h3, #study-design .dive-stats h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 13px; text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; color: var(--ink); }
  #study-design .dive-visual svg { width: 100%; height: 180px; display: block; overflow: visible; }
  #study-design .dive-grid { stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1; }
  #study-design .dive-path { fill: none; stroke: var(--accent); stroke-width: 3; }
  #study-design .dive-surface { stroke: var(--ink-2); stroke-width: 1.5; }
  #study-design .dive-label { fill: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 11px; }
  #study-design .dive-kpis { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; }
  #study-design .dive-kpi { background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 7px; padding: 9px; }
  #study-design .dive-kpi .k { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 10px; }
  #study-design .dive-kpi .v { font-family: var(--mono); font-weight: 700; margin-top: 2px; }
  #study-design .profile-marker { stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 1.5; }
  #study-design .assumptions { margin-top: 14px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  #study-design .assumptions summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-ink); }
  #study-design .assumptions ul { margin-bottom: 0; }

  /* ---- 3D seafloor view ---- */
  #dive3d { margin-top: 26px; }
  #dive3d .d3-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 18px; align-items: baseline; }
  #dive3d h2 { margin: 0; }
  #dive3d .d3-controls {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 18px; align-items: center;
    background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 14px; margin: 12px 0;
  }
  #dive3d .d3-controls label { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
  #dive3d .d3-controls input[type="number"] { width: 82px; }
  #dive3d .d3-controls .mode { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
  #dive3d #d3-build { margin-left: auto; }
  #dive3d .plotwrap {
    position: relative; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface); min-height: 200px;
  }
  #dive3d #d3-plot { width: 100%; height: 560px; }
  #dive3d .d3-status {
    padding: 22px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-3); text-align: center;
  }
  #dive3d .d3-status.err { color: var(--warn); }
  #dive3d .d3-stats {
    display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px 26px; margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2);
  }
  #dive3d .d3-stats b { color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  #dive3d .d3-credit { margin-top: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-3); }
  @media (max-width: 700px) { #dive3d #d3-plot { height: 420px; } }

  .leaflet-container { font-family: var(--sans); }
  #study-map .leaflet-top, #study-map .leaflet-bottom { z-index: 1000; pointer-events: none; }
  #study-map .leaflet-control { pointer-events: auto; }
  .leaflet-draw-toolbar a { background-color: #fff; }
  .leaflet-draw { display: block !important; visibility: visible !important; }
  .leaflet-draw-toolbar { display: block !important; visibility: visible !important; }
  .leaflet-draw-toolbar a {
    display: block !important;
    visibility: visible !important;
    width: 30px !important;
    height: 30px !important;
  }

  @media (max-width: 980px) {
    #study-design .layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #study-map { height: 560px; min-height: 460px; }
    #study-design .metrics { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
    #study-design .dive-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 560px) {
    #study-design .metrics, #study-design .two { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

.dev-subtitle {
  margin: 0.25rem 0 1.25rem 0;
  padding: 0.7rem 0.9rem;
  border-left: 5px solid #D97706;
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.10);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.approx-badge {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 0.35rem;
  padding: 0.08rem 0.4rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.14);
  color: #A35400;
  font-weight: 800;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.land-note {
  margin-top: 0.45rem;
  font-size: 0.86rem;
  line-height: 1.35;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color, #5f6b72);
}

.land-mask-status {
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.leaflet-pane.leaflet-land-pane {
  pointer-events: none;
}


  #study-design .gps-box {
    margin-top: 12px; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  #study-design .gps-box textarea {
    width: 100%; min-height: 105px; resize: vertical;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4;
    color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 7px; padding: 8px 9px;
  }
  #study-design .gps-help { color: var(--ink-3); font-size: 12px; margin: 5px 0 0; }
  #study-design .export-actions { margin-top: 10px; }
  #study-design .surface-marker { pointer-events: none; }


  #study-design .area-mode {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0 12px;
  }
  #study-design .area-mode label {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 9px 10px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface);
    color: var(--ink-2); font-size: 13px;
  }
  #study-design .area-mode input { accent-color: var(--accent); }
  #study-design .area-method {
    transition: opacity .15s ease, filter .15s ease;
  }
  #study-design .area-method.inactive {
    opacity: .38;
    filter: grayscale(.15);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  #study-design .area-method.active {
    opacity: 1;
  }


  #study-design .vertex-editor {
    margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2);
  }
  #study-design .vertex-editor[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  #study-design .vertex-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12px; }
  #study-design .vertex-table th, #study-design .vertex-table td { padding: 4px; vertical-align: middle; }
  #study-design .vertex-table th { text-align: left; color: var(--ink-3); font-weight: 700; }
  #study-design .vertex-table input {
    width: 100%; min-width: 0; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px;
    padding: 5px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: 5px;
    background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink);
  }
  #study-design .vertex-table button {
    white-space: nowrap; font-size: 11px; padding: 5px 7px;
  }

</style>

<div id="study-design">
  <header class="page-head">
    <p>Draw a study area, choose a simple transect design, and estimate survey distance and nominal mission duration. This prototype is intended for first-order study design rather than operational mission planning.</p>
  </header>

  <div class="layout">
    <section class="panel controls">
      <h2>Study requirements</h2>
      <p class="note">Use the polygon tool on the map to define one study area. Edit the polygon at any time; the design will update when you regenerate it.</p>

      <h3>Survey geometry</h3>
      <div class="field">
        <label for="pattern"><b>Survey pattern</b></label>
        <select id="pattern">
          <option value="lawnmower" selected>Lawnmower (connected transects)</option>
          <option value="parallel">Parallel transects only</option>
        </select>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label for="spacing"><b>Transect spacing</b><span class="val"><span id="spacing-val">10</span> km</span></label>
        <input id="spacing" type="range" min="1" max="50" step="1" value="10">
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label for="bearing"><b>Track orientation</b><span class="val"><span id="bearing-val">0</span>&deg;</span></label>
        <input id="bearing" type="range" min="0" max="179" step="1" value="0">
        <p class="note">0&deg; = north-south transects; 90&deg; = east-west.</p>
      </div>

      <h3>Mission assumptions</h3>
      <div class="field">
        <label for="speed"><b>Nominal horizontal speed</b><span class="val"><span id="speed-val">0.50</span> kt</span></label>
        <input id="speed" type="range" min="0.1" max="2.0" step="0.05" value="0.5">
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label for="glide-angle"><b>Glide angle</b><span class="val"><span id="glide-angle-val">26</span>&deg;</span></label>
        <input id="glide-angle" type="range" min="10" max="45" step="1" value="26">
        <p class="note">Angle from horizontal. Used with target depth to estimate the horizontal distance of one down-and-up dive cycle.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="two">
        <div class="field">
          <label for="depth"><b>Target depth</b></label>
          <input id="depth" type="number" min="1" max="6000" step="10" value="500">
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="gliders"><b>Number of gliders</b></label>
          <input id="gliders" type="number" min="1" max="20" step="1" value="1">
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3>Study area input</h3>
      <div class="area-mode" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Study area input method">
        <label><input type="radio" name="area-mode" value="draw" checked> Draw polygon</label>
        <label><input type="radio" name="area-mode" value="gps"> Enter GPS points</label>
      </div>

      <div class="area-method active" id="area-method-draw">
        <div class="actions" style="margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0;">
          <button class="btn" id="draw-area">Draw study area</button>
          <button class="btn" id="finish-area" disabled>Finish polygon</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="area-method inactive" id="area-method-gps">
        <div class="gps-box" style="margin-top:0;padding-top:0;border-top:0;">
          <div class="field" style="margin-bottom:8px;">
            <label for="gps-points"><b>GPS vertices</b></label>
            <textarea id="gps-points" placeholder="36.95, -122.35&#10;36.95, -121.85&#10;36.55, -121.78&#10;36.48, -122.25"></textarea>
            <p class="gps-help">Enter one vertex per line as <b>latitude, longitude</b>. At least three valid points are required; the polygon closes automatically.</p>
          </div>
          <button class="btn ghost" id="load-gps" type="button">Use GPS points</button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="actions">
        <button class="btn ghost" id="edit-area" disabled>Edit polygon</button>
        <button class="btn" id="clear-area">Clear area</button>
        <button class="btn" id="generate" disabled>Generate survey</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="clear-tracks" disabled>Clear tracks</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="export-geojson" disabled>Export GeoJSON</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="export-csv" disabled>Export waypoints CSV</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" id="example-area">Load example</button>
      </div>

      <div class="vertex-editor" id="vertex-editor" hidden>
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:6px;">
          <b>Edit polygon vertices</b>
          <button class="btn ghost" id="close-vertex-editor" type="button">Close</button>
        </div>
        <p class="gps-help" id="vertex-edit-status">Change coordinates directly, or choose <b>Move on map</b> and click the new location.</p>
        <table class="vertex-table">
          <thead><tr><th>#</th><th>Latitude</th><th>Longitude</th><th></th></tr></thead>
          <tbody id="vertex-table-body"></tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </section>

    <section class="panel map-panel">
      <div id="study-map" aria-label="Interactive map for drawing the study area"></div>
      <div class="map-help"><b>Study area:</b> choose either <b>Draw polygon</b> or <b>Enter GPS points</b>. After creating the polygon, use <b>Edit polygon</b> to change coordinates or reposition a vertex with a map click.</div>
      <div class="map-help"><b>Map layers:</b> <span style="color:#0057B8;font-weight:800;">blue lines</span> = survey track; <span style="color:#F28E2B;font-weight:800;">orange dots</span> = estimated surfacing locations.</div>
      <div class="map-help"><b>Land mask:</b> shaded land is shown for visual guidance only. Survey tracks are not yet routed around land, so route distance and mission duration should be treated as approximate.</div>
      <div id="land-mask-status" class="land-mask-status">Loading land mask…</div>
    </section>
  </div>

  <section class="summary">
    <h2>Survey estimate</h2>
    <p class="note">Values below are geometric and first-order estimates. Currents, dive behavior, bathymetry, payload power, navigation, launch/recovery, and operational safety margins are not yet included.</p>
    <div class="dive-card" id="dive-preview">
      <div class="dive-visual">
        <h3>Idealized dive cycle</h3>
        <svg id="dive-svg" viewBox="0 0 620 180" role="img" aria-label="Idealized glider sawtooth dive cycle">
          <line class="dive-surface" x1="52" y1="32" x2="590" y2="32"></line>
          <line class="dive-grid" x1="52" y1="150" x2="590" y2="150"></line>
          <polyline id="dive-path" class="dive-path" points="80,32 320,150 560,32"></polyline>
          <circle cx="80" cy="32" r="5" fill="#86570A"></circle>
          <circle cx="560" cy="32" r="5" fill="#86570A"></circle>
          <text class="dive-label" x="6" y="36">Surface</text>
          <text id="dive-depth-label" class="dive-label" x="6" y="154">500 m</text>
          <text id="dive-distance-label" class="dive-label" x="320" y="174" text-anchor="middle">2.05 km per cycle</text>
          <text id="dive-angle-label" class="dive-label" x="174" y="78">26&deg;</text>
        </svg>
      </div>
      <div class="dive-stats">
        <h3>Dive-cycle estimate</h3>
        <div class="dive-kpis">
          <div class="dive-kpi"><div class="k">Cycle distance</div><div class="v" id="m-cycle-distance">--</div></div>
          <div class="dive-kpi"><div class="k">Half-cycle</div><div class="v" id="m-half-cycle">--</div></div>
          <div class="dive-kpi"><div class="k">Approx. cycles</div><div class="v" id="m-cycles">--</div></div>
          <div class="dive-kpi"><div class="k">Profiles / 100 km</div><div class="v" id="m-profile-density">--</div></div>
          <div class="dive-kpi"><div class="k">Surfacing markers</div><div class="v" id="m-surface-markers">--</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="note" style="margin-top:9px;">Orange dots on the map show estimated surfacing locations along the generated route. Depth and glide-angle changes update this preview immediately.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="summary-empty" class="empty">Draw a study polygon and press <b>Generate survey</b> to create an estimate.</div>
    <div id="summary-results" hidden>
      <div class="metrics">
        <div class="metric"><div class="k">Study area</div><div class="v" id="m-area">--</div><div class="sub">polygon area</div></div>
        <div class="metric"><div class="k">Transects</div><div class="v" id="m-transects">--</div><div class="sub">inside study area</div></div>
        <div class="metric"><div class="k">Track length</div><div class="v" id="m-distance">--</div><div class="sub">survey route</div></div>
        <div class="metric"><div class="k">Nominal duration</div><div class="v" id="m-duration">--</div><div class="sub">distance / aggregate speed</div></div>
        <div class="metric"><div class="k">Target depth</div><div class="v" id="m-depth">--</div><div class="sub">user requirement</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="status">
        <div class="status-row warn"><span class="ic">~</span><span><b>Duration is derived.</b> It assumes constant horizontal speed and an even division of route distance among gliders.</span></div>
        <div class="status-row warn"><span class="ic">!</span><span><b>Not an operational plan.</b> Currents, bathymetry, energy use, station keeping, and deployment logistics are not modeled.</span></div>
        <div class="status-row ok"><span class="ic">+</span><span><b>Geometry is reproducible.</b> Area, transect count, and route length are calculated directly from the polygon and generated tracks.</span></div>
      </div>
      <details class="assumptions">
        <summary>Calculation assumptions</summary>
        <ul>
          <li>Transects are generated at the selected compass orientation and clipped to the study polygon.</li>
          <li>For the lawnmower option, transect segments are alternated and connected in sequence; connector distance is included.</li>
          <li>Nominal travel rate is speed in knots &times; 1.852 km/nmi &times; 24 h/day.</li>
          <li>Dive-cycle horizontal distance is approximated as 2 &times; target depth / tan(glide angle), assuming a symmetric straight-line descent and ascent.</li>
          <li>Map dots represent estimated surfacing locations, not subsurface profile positions or commanded waypoints.</li>
          <li>With multiple gliders, route distance is divided evenly among vehicles for the duration estimate only; tracks are not yet spatially assigned to individual gliders.</li>
        </ul>
      </details>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>



<section id="dive3d">
  <div class="d3-head">
    <h2>The mission over the seafloor</h2>
  </div>
  <p class="note">Draws the planned track as it would actually be flown, against real bathymetry for
  the study area. Dive depth can follow the seafloor instead of being fixed, which is what a pilot
  would really do over a shelf break or a canyon.</p>

  <div class="d3-controls">
    <div class="mode">
      <label><input type="radio" name="d3-mode" value="fixed" checked> Fixed depth</label>
      <label><input type="radio" name="d3-mode" value="bathy"> Follow the seafloor</label>
    </div>
    <label>Clearance above seabed
      <input type="number" id="d3-margin" value="50" min="5" max="500" step="5"> m</label>
    <button id="d3-build" class="btn" type="button" disabled>Build 3D view</button>
  </div>

  <div class="plotwrap">
    <div id="d3-plot" hidden></div>
    <div class="d3-status" id="d3-status">Draw a study area and press Generate survey, then build the 3D view.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="d3-stats" id="d3-stats" hidden>
    <div>Dives <b id="d3-n">&ndash;</b></div>
    <div>Deepest <b id="d3-max">&ndash;</b></div>
    <div>Mean dive <b id="d3-mean">&ndash;</b></div>
    <div>Seabed range <b id="d3-bed">&ndash;</b></div>
    <div>Grid <b id="d3-grid">&ndash;</b></div>
    <div>Too shallow to dive <b id="d3-shallow">&ndash;</b></div>
  </div>

  <p class="d3-credit">Bathymetry from the
  <a href="https://www.gmrt.org/">GMRT Synthesis</a> (Ryan et al., <i>Geochem. Geophys. Geosyst.</i>, 2009),
  fetched live for the drawn area. The 3D view follows
  <a href="https://github.com/Orlando-PB/glider-playground">Glider Playground</a>
  (Orlando Prugel-Bennett, National Oceanography Centre, Apache&nbsp;2.0).</p>
</section>

<div class="land-note">
  <strong>Distance note:</strong> route distance and mission duration are first-order estimates. The current planner does not yet remove over-land transect segments or calculate water-only transit paths around coastlines, islands, or other barriers.
</div>

<script>
/* 3D seafloor + dive view. Reads the planned route from window.studyDesign, fetches
   bathymetry for the study area, and walks a saw-tooth dive profile along the track.

   Bathymetry: GMRT GridServer, which sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin, so the browser
   can fetch an arbitrary area directly. NOAA's ERDDAP (what Glider Playground uses
   server-side) does not, so it cannot be called from a published page. */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const GMRT = 'https://www.gmrt.org/services/GridServer';
  const MAX_SURFACE = 110;     // grid columns/rows sent to Plotly; the full grid is kept for depth lookup
  const MAX_POINTS = 6000;     // guard against a huge area generating an unbounded track
  const MIN_DIVE = 15;         // below this a dive is not worth planning; water this shallow is flagged

  const statusEl = document.getElementById('d3-status');
  const plotEl = document.getElementById('d3-plot');
  const statsEl = document.getElementById('d3-stats');
  const buildBtn = document.getElementById('d3-build');
  const marginEl = document.getElementById('d3-margin');
  const modeEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="d3-mode"]'));

  const mode = () => (modeEls.find((r) => r.checked) || {}).value || 'fixed';
  const say = (msg, isErr) => {
    statusEl.textContent = msg;
    statusEl.classList.toggle('err', !!isErr);
    statusEl.hidden = false;
    plotEl.hidden = true;
  };

  window.addEventListener('studydesign:generated', () => {
    buildBtn.disabled = false;
    say('Survey generated. Press "Build 3D view" to fetch bathymetry for this area.');
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- bathymetry
  /* GMRT returns an ESRI ASCII grid: six header lines, then rows north to south. */
  function parseEsriAscii(text) {
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    const head = {};
    let i = 0;
    for (; i < lines.length; i++) {
      const m = lines[i].trim().match(/^([A-Za-z_]+)\s+(-?[\d.eE+]+)$/);
      if (!m) break;
      head[m[1].toLowerCase()] = parseFloat(m[2]);
    }
    const ncols = head.ncols, nrows = head.nrows, cell = head.cellsize;
    const nodata = head.nodata_value;
    const z = [];
    for (let r = 0; r < nrows; r++) {
      const row = (lines[i + r] || '').trim();
      if (!row) break;
      const vals = row.split(/\s+/).map(Number);
      z.push(vals.map((v) => (v === nodata || !isFinite(v) ? null : v)));
    }
    // Flip to south-to-north so the row index increases with latitude, as Plotly expects.
    z.reverse();
    const lons = Array.from({ length: ncols }, (_, c) => head.xllcorner + (c + 0.5) * cell);
    const lats = Array.from({ length: z.length }, (_, r) => head.yllcorner + (r + 0.5) * cell);
    return { lons, lats, z, cell };
  }

  async function fetchBathy(bbox) {
    const [w, s, e, n] = bbox;
    const pad = Math.max(0.01, Math.max(e - w, n - s) * 0.05);
    const url = `${GMRT}?minlongitude=${(w - pad).toFixed(4)}&maxlongitude=${(e + pad).toFixed(4)}` +
                `&minlatitude=${(s - pad).toFixed(4)}&maxlatitude=${(n + pad).toFixed(4)}` +
                `&format=esriascii&resolution=low&layer=topo`;
    const resp = await fetch(url);
    if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(`GMRT returned HTTP ${resp.status}`);
    const grid = parseEsriAscii(await resp.text());
    if (!grid.z.length || !grid.z[0].length) throw new Error('GMRT returned an empty grid');
    return grid;
  }

  /* Nearest-cell depth, in metres below sea level (positive down). null over land or gaps. */
  function seabedAt(grid, lon, lat) {
    const c = Math.round((lon - grid.lons[0]) / grid.cell);
    const r = Math.round((lat - grid.lats[0]) / grid.cell);
    if (r < 0 || r >= grid.z.length || c < 0 || c >= grid.z[0].length) return null;
    const v = grid.z[r][c];
    if (v === null || v >= 0) return null;          // land, or above sea level
    return -v;
  }

  function subsample(grid) {
    const stepC = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(grid.z[0].length / MAX_SURFACE));
    const stepR = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(grid.z.length / MAX_SURFACE));
    const lons = grid.lons.filter((_, i) => i % stepC === 0);
    const lats = grid.lats.filter((_, i) => i % stepR === 0);
    const z = grid.z.filter((_, r) => r % stepR === 0).map((row) => row.filter((_, c) => c % stepC === 0));
    return { lons, lats, z };
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- dive profile
  /* Walk the planned line, alternating surface and apex. Each half cycle runs
     depth / tan(glide angle) horizontally, so when the depth follows the seabed the
     dives genuinely lengthen in deep water and shorten over a bank. */
  function diveProfile(line, grid, opts) {
    const tan = Math.tan(opts.glideAngleDeg * Math.PI / 180);
    const totalKm = turf.length(line, { units: 'kilometers' });
    const pts = [];
    let dist = 0, down = true, guard = 0, tooShallow = 0;
    const bedRange = { min: Infinity, max: -Infinity };
    const depths = [];

    while (dist <= totalKm && guard++ < MAX_POINTS) {
      const p = turf.along(line, dist, { units: 'kilometers' });
      const [lon, lat] = p.geometry.coordinates;
      const bed = seabedAt(grid, lon, lat);
      if (bed !== null) {
        bedRange.min = Math.min(bedRange.min, bed);
        bedRange.max = Math.max(bedRange.max, bed);
      }

      // Fixed mode means fixed: the track is NOT clipped to the seabed, so a plan that
      // would fly into the shelf shows itself by passing under the surface in the plot.
      // Only "follow the seabed" trades depth for clearance.
      let target = opts.fixedDepth;
      if (opts.mode === 'bathy' && bed !== null) {
        target = Math.min(opts.fixedDepth, bed - opts.margin);
      }
      target = Math.max(MIN_DIVE, target);
      if (opts.mode === 'bathy' && bed !== null && bed - opts.margin < MIN_DIVE) tooShallow++;

      pts.push([lon, lat, down ? -target : 0]);
      if (down) depths.push(target);

      const halfKm = target / tan / 1000;
      if (!isFinite(halfKm) || halfKm <= 0.001) break;
      dist += halfKm;
      down = !down;
    }
    return { pts, depths, bedRange, tooShallow, truncated: guard >= MAX_POINTS };
  }

  function routeLine(geom) {
    if (!geom) return null;
    if (geom.type === 'route') return geom.line;
    // Parallel transects: stitch them into one path so the profile runs continuously.
    const coords = [];
    geom.lines.forEach((seg) => {
      const c = seg.geometry.coordinates;
      (coords.length && c.length ? c : c).forEach((xy) => coords.push(xy));
    });
    return coords.length > 1 ? turf.lineString(coords) : null;
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- render
  async function build() {
    const sd = window.studyDesign;
    if (!sd || !sd.geometry) { say('Generate a survey first.', true); return; }
    const line = routeLine(sd.geometry);
    if (!line) { say('No usable track in the generated survey.', true); return; }

    buildBtn.disabled = true;
    say('Fetching bathymetry for the study area…');
    let grid;
    try {
      grid = await fetchBathy(turf.bbox(sd.polygon));
    } catch (err) {
      say('Could not load bathymetry: ' + err.message + '. The GMRT service may be busy — try again.', true);
      buildBtn.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    const opts = {
      mode: mode(),
      margin: Math.max(5, Number(marginEl.value) || 50),
      fixedDepth: Math.max(10, Number(sd.els.depth.value) || 200),
      glideAngleDeg: sd.glideAngleDeg
    };
    const prof = diveProfile(line, grid, opts);
    if (!prof.pts.length) { say('The track produced no dives.', true); buildBtn.disabled = false; return; }

    const surf = subsample(grid);
    const midLat = (surf.lats[0] + surf.lats[surf.lats.length - 1]) / 2;
    const dx = (surf.lons[surf.lons.length - 1] - surf.lons[0]) * Math.cos(midLat * Math.PI / 180);
    const dy = surf.lats[surf.lats.length - 1] - surf.lats[0];
    const span = Math.max(dx, dy) || 1;

    const dark = document.body.classList.contains('quarto-dark');
    const ink = dark ? '#E8EEF0' : '#1F2C31';
    const gridc = dark ? '#3A3A3A' : '#DAE3E5';

    const traces = [{
      type: 'surface', x: surf.lons, y: surf.lats, z: surf.z,
      // Plotly's Earth scale already runs blue (deep) -> green -> brown (high);
      // reversing it painted the abyss pale and the land blue.
      colorscale: 'Earth', showscale: true,
      colorbar: { title: { text: 'Seabed (m)', font: { color: ink } }, tickfont: { color: ink }, len: 0.55, thickness: 12 },
      contours: { z: { show: true, usecolormap: true, width: 1, highlightcolor: '#ffffff' } },
      hovertemplate: 'lon %{x:.3f}<br>lat %{y:.3f}<br>seabed %{z:.0f} m<extra></extra>',
      name: 'Seafloor'
    }, {
      type: 'scatter3d', mode: 'lines',
      x: prof.pts.map((p) => p[0]), y: prof.pts.map((p) => p[1]), z: prof.pts.map((p) => p[2]),
      line: { width: 4, color: '#2780E3' },
      hovertemplate: 'lon %{x:.3f}<br>lat %{y:.3f}<br>depth %{z:.0f} m<extra></extra>',
      name: 'Planned dives'
    }];

    const layout = {
      margin: { l: 0, r: 0, t: 0, b: 0 },
      paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
      showlegend: true,
      legend: { x: 0, y: 1, font: { color: ink } },
      scene: {
        xaxis: { title: { text: 'Longitude', font: { color: ink } }, color: ink, gridcolor: gridc },
        yaxis: { title: { text: 'Latitude', font: { color: ink } }, color: ink, gridcolor: gridc },
        zaxis: { title: { text: 'Depth (m)', font: { color: ink } }, color: ink, gridcolor: gridc },
        aspectmode: 'manual',
        aspectratio: { x: dx / span, y: dy / span, z: 0.45 },
        camera: { eye: { x: 1.5, y: -1.5, z: 0.9 } }
      }
    };

    plotEl.hidden = false;
    statusEl.hidden = true;
    await Plotly.newPlot(plotEl, traces, layout, { responsive: true, displaylogo: false });

    const d = prof.depths;
    const mean = d.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / (d.length || 1);
    document.getElementById('d3-n').textContent = d.length + (prof.truncated ? '+' : '');
    document.getElementById('d3-max').textContent = Math.round(Math.max.apply(null, d)) + ' m';
    document.getElementById('d3-mean').textContent = Math.round(mean) + ' m';
    document.getElementById('d3-bed').textContent = isFinite(prof.bedRange.min)
      ? Math.round(prof.bedRange.min) + '–' + Math.round(prof.bedRange.max) + ' m' : 'no data';
    document.getElementById('d3-grid').textContent = surf.z[0].length + '×' + surf.z.length;
    document.getElementById('d3-shallow').textContent = opts.mode === 'bathy'
      ? prof.tooShallow + ' points' : 'n/a (fixed depth)';
    statsEl.hidden = false;
    buildBtn.disabled = false;

    if (prof.truncated) {
      say('Track truncated at ' + MAX_POINTS + ' points — the area is very large for this dive depth.', true);
      statusEl.hidden = false;
      plotEl.hidden = false;
    }
  }

  buildBtn.addEventListener('click', build);
  modeEls.forEach((r) => r.addEventListener('change', () => {
    marginEl.disabled = mode() !== 'bathy';
  }));
  marginEl.disabled = true;
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  const els = {
    spacing: document.getElementById('spacing'),
    spacingVal: document.getElementById('spacing-val'),
    bearing: document.getElementById('bearing'),
    bearingVal: document.getElementById('bearing-val'),
    speed: document.getElementById('speed'),
    speedVal: document.getElementById('speed-val'),
    glideAngle: document.getElementById('glide-angle'),
    glideAngleVal: document.getElementById('glide-angle-val'),
    depth: document.getElementById('depth'),
    gliders: document.getElementById('gliders'),
    pattern: document.getElementById('pattern'),
    drawArea: document.getElementById('draw-area'),
    finishArea: document.getElementById('finish-area'),
    areaModeDraw: document.getElementById('area-method-draw'),
    areaModeGps: document.getElementById('area-method-gps'),
    editArea: document.getElementById('edit-area'),
    vertexEditor: document.getElementById('vertex-editor'),
    vertexTableBody: document.getElementById('vertex-table-body'),
    vertexEditStatus: document.getElementById('vertex-edit-status'),
    closeVertexEditor: document.getElementById('close-vertex-editor'),
    clearArea: document.getElementById('clear-area'),
    generate: document.getElementById('generate'),
    clearTracks: document.getElementById('clear-tracks'),
    gpsPoints: document.getElementById('gps-points'),
    loadGps: document.getElementById('load-gps'),
    exportGeojson: document.getElementById('export-geojson'),
    exportCsv: document.getElementById('export-csv'),
    exampleArea: document.getElementById('example-area')
  };

  els.spacing.addEventListener('input', () => els.spacingVal.textContent = els.spacing.value);
  els.bearing.addEventListener('input', () => els.bearingVal.textContent = els.bearing.value);
  els.speed.addEventListener('input', () => els.speedVal.textContent = Number(els.speed.value).toFixed(2));
  els.glideAngle.addEventListener('input', () => els.glideAngleVal.textContent = els.glideAngle.value);

  const map = L.map('study-map', { zoomControl: true }).setView([36.75, -122.0], 7);
  // Esri World Ocean Base, the same basemap Glider Playground uses
  // (github.com/Orlando-PB/glider-playground). It shades bathymetry, which a street
  // map does not, so a study area reads against the shelf and canyons it sits on.
  // Note the {z}/{y}/{x} order: ArcGIS puts row before column.
  const baseTiles = L.tileLayer(
    'https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/Ocean/World_Ocean_Base/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}', {
    maxZoom: 19,
    maxNativeZoom: 13,   // the service stops here; beyond it Leaflet upscales rather than blanking
    tileSize: 256,
    updateWhenIdle: true,
    keepBuffer: 4,
    attribution: 'Tiles &copy; Esri &mdash; Sources: GEBCO, NOAA, National Geographic, ' +
                 'Garmin, HERE, Geonames.org and other contributors'
  }).addTo(map);

  // Log true network failures separately from layout/CSS problems.
  baseTiles.on('tileerror', (e) => {
    console.warn('Basemap tile failed to load:', e.tile?.src || e);
  });

  const drawnItems = new L.FeatureGroup().addTo(map);
  const trackLayer = new L.FeatureGroup().addTo(map);

  // Estimated surfacing locations use Leaflet's standard vector pane.
  // This is more stable across zoom levels than a custom SVG pane.
  const surfaceLayer = new L.FeatureGroup().addTo(map);

  const drawControl = new L.Control.Draw({
    position: 'topleft',
    draw: {
      polygon: {
        allowIntersection: false,
        showArea: true,
        shapeOptions: { color: '#2780E3', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.12 }
      },
      polyline: false,
      rectangle: false,
      circle: false,
      circlemarker: false,
      marker: false
    },
    edit: { featureGroup: drawnItems, remove: true }
  });
  // Leaflet.draw toolbar is not used for polygon creation; custom click-to-add controls are more reliable in Quarto.
  // map.addControl(drawControl);

  // Prominent alternative to the small Leaflet.draw toolbar icon.
  // This also makes polygon drawing usable if Quarto/theme CSS makes the toolbar icon hard to notice.
  let manualDrawing = false;
  let manualVertices = [];
  let manualGuide = null;
  let manualVertexLayer = L.layerGroup().addTo(map);
  let movingVertexIndex = null;


  function resetManualGuide() {
    if (manualGuide) {
      map.removeLayer(manualGuide);
      manualGuide = null;
    }
    manualVertexLayer.clearLayers();
  }

  function updateManualGuide() {
    if (manualGuide) map.removeLayer(manualGuide);
    if (manualVertices.length >= 2) {
      manualGuide = L.polyline(manualVertices, {
        color: '#0057B8',
        weight: 3,
        opacity: 1,
        dashArray: '6,6'
      }).addTo(map);
    }
    manualVertexLayer.clearLayers();
    manualVertices.forEach((latlng, i) => {
      L.circleMarker(latlng, {
        radius: 5,
        color: '#0057B8',
        weight: 2,
        fillColor: '#ffffff',
        fillOpacity: 1
      }).bindTooltip(`Vertex ${i + 1}`, {permanent: false}).addTo(manualVertexLayer);
    });
    els.finishArea.disabled = manualVertices.length < 3;
  }


  function setAreaMode(mode) {
    const drawMode = mode === 'draw';
    els.areaModeDraw.classList.toggle('active', drawMode);
    els.areaModeDraw.classList.toggle('inactive', !drawMode);
    els.areaModeGps.classList.toggle('active', !drawMode);
    els.areaModeGps.classList.toggle('inactive', drawMode);

    if (!drawMode) {
      manualDrawing = false;
      resetManualGuide();
      els.drawArea.textContent = 'Draw study area';
      els.finishArea.disabled = true;
      map.getContainer().style.cursor = '';
    }
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('input[name="area-mode"]').forEach(radio => {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (this.checked) setAreaMode(this.value);
    });
  });

  setAreaMode(document.querySelector('input[name="area-mode"]:checked')?.value || 'draw');

  els.drawArea.addEventListener('click', function () {
    const drawRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="area-mode"][value="draw"]');
    if (drawRadio) drawRadio.checked = true;
    setAreaMode('draw');
    manualDrawing = true;
    manualVertices = [];
    resetManualGuide();
    els.finishArea.disabled = true;
    els.drawArea.textContent = 'Click map to add vertices';
    map.getContainer().style.cursor = 'crosshair';
  });

  els.finishArea.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (manualVertices.length < 3) return;
    installStudyPolygon(manualVertices.slice());
  });

  els.clearArea.addEventListener('click', function () {
    closeVertexEditor();
    manualDrawing = false;
    manualVertices = [];
    resetManualGuide();
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    if (typeof clearSurvey === 'function') clearSurvey();
    els.drawArea.textContent = 'Draw study area';
    els.finishArea.disabled = true;
    els.generate.disabled = true;
    map.getContainer().style.cursor = '';
  });

  map.on('click', function (e) {
    if (movingVertexIndex !== null) {
      const idx = movingVertexIndex;
      movingVertexIndex = null;
      updatePolygonVertex(idx, e.latlng.lat, e.latlng.lng);
      els.vertexEditStatus.innerHTML = 'Change coordinates directly, or choose <b>Move on map</b> and click the new location.';
      map.getContainer().style.cursor = '';
      return;
    }
    if (!manualDrawing) return;
    manualVertices.push(e.latlng);
    updateManualGuide();
  });


  function parseGpsVertices(raw) {
    const points = [];
    const errors = [];
    raw.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((line, index) => {
      const trimmed = line.trim();
      if (!trimmed) return;
      const parts = trimmed.split(/[,\t ]+/).filter(Boolean);
      if (parts.length < 2) {
        errors.push(`line ${index + 1}`);
        return;
      }
      const lat = Number(parts[0]);
      const lng = Number(parts[1]);
      if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng) ||
          lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180) {
        errors.push(`line ${index + 1}`);
        return;
      }
      points.push(L.latLng(lat, lng));
    });
    return { points, errors };
  }

  function installStudyPolygon(latlngs) {
    if (latlngs.length < 3) return null;
    closeVertexEditor();
    manualDrawing = false;
    manualVertices = [];
    resetManualGuide();
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    clearTracksAndSummary();
    const poly = L.polygon(latlngs, {
      color: '#0057B8', weight: 3, opacity: 1, fillOpacity: 0.12
    }).addTo(drawnItems);
    els.drawArea.textContent = 'Draw study area';
    els.finishArea.disabled = true;
    map.getContainer().style.cursor = '';
    map.fitBounds(poly.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
    setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize({ pan: false }), 50);
    setButtons();
    return poly;
  }

  els.loadGps.addEventListener('click', function () {
    const gpsRadio = document.querySelector('input[name="area-mode"][value="gps"]');
    if (gpsRadio) gpsRadio.checked = true;
    setAreaMode('gps');
    const parsed = parseGpsVertices(els.gpsPoints.value);
    if (parsed.errors.length) {
      alert(`Could not read GPS coordinates on ${parsed.errors.join(', ')}. Use one latitude, longitude pair per line.`);
      return;
    }
    if (parsed.points.length < 3) {
      alert('Please enter at least three valid GPS points.');
      return;
    }
    installStudyPolygon(parsed.points);
  });

  function getPolygonVertices(layer) {
    if (!layer) return [];
    const latlngs = layer.getLatLngs();
    if (!Array.isArray(latlngs) || !latlngs.length) return [];
    return Array.isArray(latlngs[0]) ? latlngs[0] : latlngs;
  }

  function updatePolygonVertex(index, lat, lng) {
    const poly = currentPolygonLayer();
    if (!poly) return;
    const vertices = getPolygonVertices(poly).map(ll => L.latLng(ll.lat, ll.lng));
    if (index < 0 || index >= vertices.length) return;
    vertices[index] = L.latLng(lat, lng);
    poly.setLatLngs(vertices);
    poly.redraw();
    clearTracksAndSummary();
    renderVertexEditor();
    setButtons();
  }

  function renderVertexEditor() {
    const poly = currentPolygonLayer();
    if (!poly || !els.vertexTableBody) return;
    const vertices = getPolygonVertices(poly);
    els.vertexTableBody.innerHTML = '';

    vertices.forEach((ll, index) => {
      const tr = document.createElement('tr');
      tr.innerHTML = `
        <td>${index + 1}</td>
        <td><input type="number" step="0.000001" value="${ll.lat.toFixed(6)}" data-vertex-lat="${index}"></td>
        <td><input type="number" step="0.000001" value="${ll.lng.toFixed(6)}" data-vertex-lng="${index}"></td>
        <td><button type="button" class="btn ghost" data-move-vertex="${index}">Move on map</button></td>`;
      els.vertexTableBody.appendChild(tr);
    });

    els.vertexTableBody.querySelectorAll('input[data-vertex-lat], input[data-vertex-lng]').forEach(input => {
      input.addEventListener('change', function () {
        const idx = Number(this.dataset.vertexLat ?? this.dataset.vertexLng);
        const latInput = els.vertexTableBody.querySelector(`input[data-vertex-lat="${idx}"]`);
        const lngInput = els.vertexTableBody.querySelector(`input[data-vertex-lng="${idx}"]`);
        const lat = Number(latInput.value);
        const lng = Number(lngInput.value);
        if (!Number.isFinite(lat) || !Number.isFinite(lng) || lat < -90 || lat > 90 || lng < -180 || lng > 180) {
          alert('Please enter valid latitude and longitude values.');
          renderVertexEditor();
          return;
        }
        updatePolygonVertex(idx, lat, lng);
      });
    });

    els.vertexTableBody.querySelectorAll('button[data-move-vertex]').forEach(button => {
      button.addEventListener('click', function () {
        movingVertexIndex = Number(this.dataset.moveVertex);
        els.vertexEditStatus.textContent = `Click the map to move vertex ${movingVertexIndex + 1}.`;
        map.getContainer().style.cursor = 'crosshair';
      });
    });
  }

  function closeVertexEditor() {
    movingVertexIndex = null;
    map.getContainer().style.cursor = manualDrawing ? 'crosshair' : '';
    if (els.vertexEditor) els.vertexEditor.hidden = true;
    if (els.editArea) els.editArea.textContent = 'Edit polygon';
    if (els.vertexEditStatus) els.vertexEditStatus.innerHTML = 'Change coordinates directly, or choose <b>Move on map</b> and click the new location.';
  }

  els.editArea.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!currentPolygonLayer()) return;
    renderVertexEditor();
    els.vertexEditor.hidden = false;
    els.editArea.textContent = 'Editing polygon';
  });

  els.closeVertexEditor.addEventListener('click', closeVertexEditor);

  function currentPolygonLayer() {
    let result = null;
    drawnItems.eachLayer(layer => { result = layer; });
    return result;
  }

  function setButtons() {
    const hasPolygon = !!currentPolygonLayer();
    els.generate.disabled = !hasPolygon;
    els.editArea.disabled = !hasPolygon;
    const hasTracks = !!lastSurveyGeometry && trackLayer.getLayers().length > 0;
    els.clearTracks.disabled = trackLayer.getLayers().length === 0;
    els.exportGeojson.disabled = !hasTracks;
    els.exportCsv.disabled = !hasTracks;
  }

  function clearTracksAndSummary() {
    trackLayer.clearLayers();
    surfaceLayer.clearLayers();
    lastSurveyGeometry = null;
    document.getElementById('summary-empty').hidden = false;
    document.getElementById('summary-results').hidden = true;
    setButtons();
  }

  map.on(L.Draw.Event.CREATED, function (e) {
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    drawnItems.addLayer(e.layer);
    clearTracksAndSummary();
    map.invalidateSize(false);
    map.fitBounds(e.layer.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
    setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize(false), 100);
    setButtons();
  });
  map.on(L.Draw.Event.EDITED, clearTracksAndSummary);
  map.on(L.Draw.Event.DELETED, clearTracksAndSummary);

  els.clearTracks.addEventListener('click', clearTracksAndSummary);

  els.exampleArea.addEventListener('click', function () {
    drawnItems.clearLayers();
    clearTracksAndSummary();
    const example = L.polygon([
      [36.95, -122.35],
      [36.95, -121.85],
      [36.55, -121.78],
      [36.48, -122.25]
    ], { color: '#2780E3', weight: 2, fillOpacity: 0.12 });
    drawnItems.addLayer(example);
    map.invalidateSize(false);
    map.fitBounds(example.getBounds(), { padding: [20, 20] });
    setTimeout(() => map.invalidateSize(false), 100);
    setButtons();
  });

  function leafletPolygonToTurf(layer) {
    const gj = layer.toGeoJSON();
    if (gj.geometry.type === 'Polygon') return gj;
    throw new Error('Study area must be a polygon.');
  }

  function rotatePointKm(x, y, degrees) {
    const r = degrees * Math.PI / 180;
    return [x * Math.cos(r) - y * Math.sin(r), x * Math.sin(r) + y * Math.cos(r)];
  }

  function localKmToLngLat(center, xKm, yKm) {
    const distance = Math.sqrt(xKm * xKm + yKm * yKm);
    if (distance === 0) return center.geometry.coordinates;
    const bearing = Math.atan2(xKm, yKm) * 180 / Math.PI;
    return turf.destination(center, distance, bearing, { units: 'kilometers' }).geometry.coordinates;
  }

  function buildCandidateLines(polygon, spacingKm, bearingDeg) {
    const center = turf.centroid(polygon);
    const bbox = turf.bbox(polygon);
    const corners = [
      turf.point([bbox[0], bbox[1]]), turf.point([bbox[0], bbox[3]]),
      turf.point([bbox[2], bbox[1]]), turf.point([bbox[2], bbox[3]])
    ];
    const radiusKm = Math.max(...corners.map(p => turf.distance(center, p, { units: 'kilometers' }))) * 1.6 + spacingKm * 2;
    const count = Math.ceil((radiusKm * 2) / spacingKm) + 2;
    const lines = [];

    for (let i = -count; i <= count; i++) {
      const offset = i * spacingKm;
      // In a local x=east, y=north frame, the transect direction is the selected bearing.
      // A line is created along local north-south, offset east-west, then rotated by bearing.
      const a0 = [-offset, -radiusKm * 1.8];
      const b0 = [-offset,  radiusKm * 1.8];
      const aRot = rotatePointKm(a0[0], a0[1], -bearingDeg);
      const bRot = rotatePointKm(b0[0], b0[1], -bearingDeg);
      lines.push(turf.lineString([
        localKmToLngLat(center, aRot[0], aRot[1]),
        localKmToLngLat(center, bRot[0], bRot[1])
      ]));
    }
    return lines;
  }

  function clipLineToPolygon(line, polygon) {
    const boundary = turf.polygonToLine(polygon);
    let pieces;
    try {
      pieces = turf.lineSplit(line, boundary);
    } catch (err) {
      pieces = turf.featureCollection([line]);
    }
    const inside = [];
    pieces.features.forEach(seg => {
      if (!seg.geometry || seg.geometry.coordinates.length < 2) return;
      const mid = turf.along(seg, turf.length(seg, { units: 'kilometers' }) / 2, { units: 'kilometers' });
      if (turf.booleanPointInPolygon(mid, polygon, { ignoreBoundary: false })) inside.push(seg);
    });
    return inside;
  }

  function segmentCenter(seg) {
    return turf.centroid(seg).geometry.coordinates;
  }

  function orderSegments(segments, bearingDeg) {
    // Order by position along the normal to the transect bearing.
    const normal = (bearingDeg + 90) * Math.PI / 180;
    return segments.slice().sort((a, b) => {
      const ca = segmentCenter(a), cb = segmentCenter(b);
      const lat0 = (ca[1] + cb[1]) / 2 * Math.PI / 180;
      const ax = ca[0] * Math.cos(lat0), ay = ca[1];
      const bx = cb[0] * Math.cos(lat0), by = cb[1];
      return (ax * Math.sin(normal) + ay * Math.cos(normal)) - (bx * Math.sin(normal) + by * Math.cos(normal));
    });
  }

  function orientSegment(seg, reverse) {
    const c = seg.geometry.coordinates.slice();
    return reverse ? c.reverse() : c;
  }

  function buildLawnmowerRoute(segments) {
    if (!segments.length) return null;
    const coords = [];
    segments.forEach((seg, i) => {
      const part = orientSegment(seg, i % 2 === 1);
      if (coords.length === 0) coords.push(...part);
      else coords.push(...part);
    });
    return turf.lineString(coords);
  }

  function drawFeature(feature, style) {
    return L.geoJSON(feature, { style }).addTo(trackLayer);
  }

  function fmt(value, digits = 0) {
    return Number(value).toLocaleString(undefined, { maximumFractionDigits: digits, minimumFractionDigits: digits });
  }

  function diveCycleDistanceKm(depthM, glideAngleDeg) {
    if (!(depthM > 0) || !(glideAngleDeg > 0 && glideAngleDeg < 90)) return NaN;
    const halfCycleM = depthM / Math.tan(glideAngleDeg * Math.PI / 180);
    return (2 * halfCycleM) / 1000;
  }

  function updateDiveGraphic(depthM, glideAngleDeg, cycleKm) {
    document.getElementById('dive-depth-label').textContent = `${fmt(depthM, 0)} m`;
    document.getElementById('dive-distance-label').textContent = `${fmt(cycleKm, cycleKm < 10 ? 2 : 1)} km per cycle`;
    document.getElementById('dive-angle-label').textContent = `${fmt(glideAngleDeg, 0)}°`;
  }

  function addSurfaceMarkersToLine(line, cycleKm) {
    if (!line || !(cycleKm > 0)) return 0;
    const lenKm = turf.length(line, { units: 'kilometers' });
    let count = 0;
    for (let d = cycleKm; d < lenKm; d += cycleKm) {
      const p = turf.along(line, d, { units: 'kilometers' });
      const [lng, lat] = p.geometry.coordinates;
      L.circleMarker([lat, lng], {
        radius: 5,
        color: '#5A3300',
        weight: 1.5,
        fillColor: '#F59E0B',
        fillOpacity: 0.95,
        interactive: false,
        pane: 'overlayPane',
        className: 'surface-marker'
      }).addTo(surfaceLayer);
      count += 1;
    }
    return count;
  }


  let lastSurveyGeometry = null;

  function updateDivePreviewOnly() {
    const depthM = Math.max(0, Number(els.depth.value) || 0);
    const glideAngleDeg = Math.max(1, Math.min(89, Number(els.glideAngle.value) || 26));
    const cycleKm = diveCycleDistanceKm(depthM, glideAngleDeg);
    if (!Number.isFinite(cycleKm) || cycleKm <= 0) return;
    updateDiveGraphic(depthM, glideAngleDeg, cycleKm);
    document.getElementById('m-cycle-distance').textContent = `${fmt(cycleKm, cycleKm < 10 ? 2 : 1)} km`;
    document.getElementById('m-half-cycle').textContent = `${fmt(cycleKm / 2, cycleKm < 10 ? 2 : 1)} km`;
    document.getElementById('m-profile-density').textContent = fmt(100 / cycleKm, 1);

    if (lastSurveyGeometry) {
      surfaceLayer.clearLayers();
      let cycles = 0;
      if (lastSurveyGeometry.type === 'route') {
        const markerCount = addSurfaceMarkersToLine(lastSurveyGeometry.line, cycleKm);
        document.getElementById('m-surface-markers').textContent = fmt(markerCount, 0);
        cycles = lastSurveyGeometry.distanceKm / cycleKm;
      } else {
        let markerCount = 0;
        lastSurveyGeometry.lines.forEach(line => { markerCount += addSurfaceMarkersToLine(line, cycleKm); });
        document.getElementById('m-surface-markers').textContent = fmt(markerCount, 0);
        cycles = lastSurveyGeometry.distanceKm / cycleKm;
      }
      document.getElementById('m-cycles').textContent = fmt(cycles, 0);
    } else {
      document.getElementById('m-cycles').textContent = '--';
      document.getElementById('m-surface-markers').textContent = '--';
    }
  }

  function surveyTrackFeatures() {
    if (!lastSurveyGeometry) return [];
    if (lastSurveyGeometry.type === 'route') {
      return [turf.feature(lastSurveyGeometry.line.geometry, {
        feature_type: 'survey_route',
        distance_km: lastSurveyGeometry.distanceKm
      })];
    }
    return lastSurveyGeometry.lines.map((line, i) =>
      turf.feature(line.geometry, { feature_type: 'transect', transect_id: i + 1 })
    );
  }

  function currentSurfacePoints() {
    const depthM = Math.max(0, Number(els.depth.value) || 0);
    const angle = Math.max(1, Math.min(89, Number(els.glideAngle.value) || 26));
    const cycleKm = diveCycleDistanceKm(depthM, angle);
    const points = [];
    let id = 1;

    function collect(line, lineId) {
      const lenKm = turf.length(line, { units: 'kilometers' });
      for (let d = cycleKm; d < lenKm; d += cycleKm) {
        const p = turf.along(line, d, { units: 'kilometers' });
        p.properties = {
          feature_type: 'estimated_surfacing',
          waypoint_id: id++,
          line_id: lineId,
          distance_along_line_km: Number(d.toFixed(3)),
          target_depth_m: depthM,
          glide_angle_deg: angle
        };
        points.push(p);
      }
    }

    if (!lastSurveyGeometry || !(cycleKm > 0)) return points;
    if (lastSurveyGeometry.type === 'route') collect(lastSurveyGeometry.line, 1);
    else lastSurveyGeometry.lines.forEach((line, i) => collect(line, i + 1));
    return points;
  }

  function downloadText(filename, mime, content) {
    const blob = new Blob([content], { type: mime });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = filename;
    document.body.appendChild(a);
    a.click();
    a.remove();
    setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
  }

  els.exportGeojson.addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!lastSurveyGeometry) return;
    const polygonLayer = currentPolygonLayer();
    const features = [];
    if (polygonLayer) {
      const study = polygonLayer.toGeoJSON();
      study.properties = { ...(study.properties || {}), feature_type: 'study_area' };
      features.push(study);
    }
    features.push(...surveyTrackFeatures(), ...currentSurfacePoints());
    downloadText(
      'glider-study-design.geojson',
      'application/geo+json;charset=utf-8',
      JSON.stringify(turf.featureCollection(features), null, 2)
    );
  });

  els.exportCsv.addEventListener('click', function () {
    const points = currentSurfacePoints();
    if (!points.length) {
      alert('No estimated surfacing waypoints are available to export.');
      return;
    }
    const rows = [
      ['waypoint_id','latitude','longitude','line_id','distance_along_line_km','target_depth_m','glide_angle_deg']
    ];
    points.forEach(p => {
      const [lng, lat] = p.geometry.coordinates;
      rows.push([
        p.properties.waypoint_id,
        lat.toFixed(7),
        lng.toFixed(7),
        p.properties.line_id,
        p.properties.distance_along_line_km,
        p.properties.target_depth_m,
        p.properties.glide_angle_deg
      ]);
    });
    downloadText(
      'glider-estimated-surfacing-waypoints.csv',
      'text/csv;charset=utf-8',
      rows.map(r => r.join(',')).join('\n')
    );
  });

  function generateSurvey() {
    const layer = currentPolygonLayer();
    if (!layer) return;

    clearTracksAndSummary();

    const polygon = leafletPolygonToTurf(layer);
    const spacingKm = Number(els.spacing.value);
    const bearing = Number(els.bearing.value);
    const speedKt = Math.max(0.01, Number(els.speed.value));
    const glideAngleDeg = Math.max(1, Math.min(89, Number(els.glideAngle.value) || 26));
    const gliders = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(els.gliders.value) || 1));
    const depthM = Math.max(0, Number(els.depth.value) || 0);
    const cycleKm = diveCycleDistanceKm(depthM, glideAngleDeg);

    const candidates = buildCandidateLines(polygon, spacingKm, bearing);
    let segments = [];
    candidates.forEach(line => { segments.push(...clipLineToPolygon(line, polygon)); });
    segments = orderSegments(segments, bearing);

    if (!segments.length) {
      document.getElementById('summary-empty').innerHTML = 'No transects were generated. Try a smaller spacing value or redraw the study area.';
      document.getElementById('summary-empty').hidden = false;
      setButtons();
      return;
    }

    let distanceKm = 0;
    let estimatedCycles = 0;
    let surfaceMarkerCount = 0;
    if (els.pattern.value === 'parallel') {
      segments.forEach(seg => {
        const segKm = turf.length(seg, { units: 'kilometers' });
        distanceKm += segKm;
        drawFeature(seg, { color: '#0057B8', weight: 4, opacity: 1.0 });
        if (Number.isFinite(cycleKm) && cycleKm > 0) {
          surfaceMarkerCount += addSurfaceMarkersToLine(seg, cycleKm);
          estimatedCycles += segKm / cycleKm;
        }
      });
      lastSurveyGeometry = { type: 'segments', lines: segments, distanceKm };
    } else {
      const route = buildLawnmowerRoute(segments);
      distanceKm = turf.length(route, { units: 'kilometers' });
      drawFeature(route, { color: '#0057B8', weight: 4, opacity: 1.0 });
      segments.forEach(seg => drawFeature(seg, { color: '#1A6B4E', weight: 5, opacity: 0.35 }));
      if (Number.isFinite(cycleKm) && cycleKm > 0) {
        surfaceMarkerCount += addSurfaceMarkersToLine(route, cycleKm);
        estimatedCycles = distanceKm / cycleKm;
      }
      lastSurveyGeometry = { type: 'route', line: route, distanceKm };
    }

    const areaKm2 = turf.area(polygon) / 1e6;
    const kmPerDayPerGlider = speedKt * 1.852 * 24;
    const days = distanceKm / (kmPerDayPerGlider * gliders);

    document.getElementById('m-area').textContent = `${fmt(areaKm2, areaKm2 < 100 ? 1 : 0)} km²`;
    document.getElementById('m-transects').textContent = fmt(segments.length, 0);
    document.getElementById('m-distance').textContent = `${fmt(distanceKm, distanceKm < 100 ? 1 : 0)} km`;
    document.getElementById('m-duration').textContent = days < 1 ? `${fmt(days * 24, 1)} h` : `${fmt(days, 1)} d`;
    document.getElementById('m-depth').textContent = `${fmt(depthM, 0)} m`;
    if (Number.isFinite(cycleKm) && cycleKm > 0) {
      document.getElementById('m-cycle-distance').textContent = `${fmt(cycleKm, cycleKm < 10 ? 2 : 1)} km`;
      document.getElementById('m-half-cycle').textContent = `${fmt(cycleKm / 2, cycleKm < 10 ? 2 : 1)} km`;
      document.getElementById('m-cycles').textContent = fmt(estimatedCycles, 0);
      document.getElementById('m-profile-density').textContent = fmt(100 / cycleKm, 1);
      document.getElementById('m-surface-markers').textContent = fmt(surfaceMarkerCount, 0);
      updateDiveGraphic(depthM, glideAngleDeg, cycleKm);
    }
    document.getElementById('summary-empty').hidden = true;
    document.getElementById('summary-results').hidden = false;
    setButtons();

    // Hook for the 3D seafloor view below; it reads the route rather than rebuilding it.
    window.studyDesign = { geometry: lastSurveyGeometry, polygon, els, cycleKm, depthM, glideAngleDeg };
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('studydesign:generated'));
  }

  els.generate.addEventListener('click', generateSurvey);
  els.depth.addEventListener('input', updateDivePreviewOnly);
  els.glideAngle.addEventListener('input', updateDivePreviewOnly);
  updateDivePreviewOnly();
  setButtons();

  // Refresh only after genuine page/window layout changes. Avoid continuously
  // invalidating during normal map interaction, which can cause unnecessary tile churn.
  let resizeTimer = null;
  function refreshMapSize() {
    clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
    resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      map.invalidateSize({ pan: false, debounceMoveend: true });
    }, 150);
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', refreshMapSize);
  window.addEventListener('load', refreshMapSize);
  setTimeout(refreshMapSize, 300);
  setTimeout(refreshMapSize, 1000);
})();
</script>
```
